SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND (state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR usage_quality='UNKNOWN') LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state='OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' LIMIT 1

UPDATE step SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},response_snapshot=IF(response_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}),request_cleanup_state='QUESTION_PURGED',retained_request_digest=request_digest WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE invocation SET input_snapshot=#{tombstone},output_snapshot=IF(output_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE user_question SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},answer_snapshot=IF(answer_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}),receipt_snapshot=IF(receipt_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}),retained_digests=#{retained} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE task SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},goal=#{tombstone},summary=IF(summary IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}),question_cleanup_state='PURGED',question_retained_digests=#{retained} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}
UPDATE reservation SET state='RELEASED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{holdId} AND state='RESERVED'
UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held-2097152 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}

phases: Outside transaction: original RETAINED + three terminal states + task.created_at <= database clock -7day, ordered created_at/id LIMIT32 cross-tenant candidates

One original tx/coreWork per candidate: tenant budget -> existing locked(scope sorted source tasks)/task; RETAINED -> original TaskOperations view with original artifact read and View.terminal predicate -> writer -> unknown reservation/usage -> OUTCOME_UNKNOWN invocation checks, preserving short circuit

Retain task/step/invocation body hash and UTF8 byte metadata in original order; MP reads only consumed key/body fields. Update step request cleanup/digest, invocation inputs/outputs with exact QUESTION_PURGED tombstone and original nullable IF

For each MP user_question, retain request/answer/receipt hash/UTF8 lengths in its own metadata, then exact tombstones with NULL retained; original request/answer digests and all unrelated columns unchanged

Purge task body and metadata -> update tenant+hold id RESERVED reservation; only affected rows ==1 subtract original2097152 storage_held -> original question-purged event and sequence/revision, all in same UoW
boundaries: Original seven-day age check exists only in candidate SQL, not rechecked or replaced by user_question.retain_until under lock. No new expiry, current permission/fence, payment or scope rule

Original View.terminal includes NEEDS_RECONCILIATION on locked recheck although candidate scan selects only SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED. Unit checks original branch; full state-change permutations not claimed
No new RUNNING invocation or DISPATCHED model restriction; only original OUTCOME_UNKNOWN branch. Model dispatch bodies/usage are not part of this cleanup and remain unchanged

Hold update lacks category predicate in original; preserve exact tenant/id/RESERVED. Zero update is successful cleanup+event without budget release, not RESERVATION_STATE refusal. No actual/amount-based release or question capacity decrement introduced
Original step/invocation/question updates use schema primary key tenant+id derived under locked parent, collection reads use tenant/task. No broad composite-key by-id or saveOrUpdate

No filesystem/provider/effect calls. SQL/event failure or query-observed deadline after refund before event rolls back body/metadata/hold/budget/event and propagates.
